annotations.title: US national debt, Treasury data: total public debt outstanding today and its change

description: US national debt from the Treasury's Debt to the Penny dataset: total public debt outstanding, debt held by the public and intragovernmental holdings (USD) at the latest record date, the change over 1 day, 30 days and 1 year, and a daily history (1-365 days). US federal data, public domain; the snapshot's record date is in the answer. Use when an agent needs the current US federal debt figure, its trend, or a daily series for a chart or brief. Example: days=30. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

days.description: Days of daily history to return, 1-365 (default 30)
